messages:
Lucas: Heads-up: Aegis Financial sent a detailed RFI. Main asks: embeddings pricing with per-month caps, POC isolation + short retention, proof of BYOK/HSM for audit, latency at 512-d vectors ~50 qps, and a written governance note for PII. I started a quick draft matrix (vector_governance_draft.xlsx).
Priya: Can you paste the exact pricing/cap questions? need to know if they want sample commit or a firm quote.
Lucas: They asked for: 1) per-embedding price with step-downs and an example 6-month commit with monthly caps, 2) whether we can enforce per-tenant cost caps during POC, 3) KMS/HSM enrollment + attestation steps, 4) single-tenant sandbox with network isolation and 7-day retention option.
Diego: Pricing suggestion to include in matrix (sample numbers):
```
Hosted: $0.00045/embedding (0-250k)
Hosted: $0.00028/embedding (250k-2M)
Dedicated commit example: $0.00016/embedding (6M/mo commit)
POC trial credit: $5,000 one-time
```
Diego: Note: include a line for "cost caps" - for Dedicated we can set spend limits + alerts; for Hosted we can enforce API key hard caps at the account level.
Marta: KMS/HSM: we support BYOK for Dedicated and Private. HSM-backed key usage is supported only in Private (on-prem or VPC with customer HSM). Attestation: we can provide KMS configuration docs and an HSM vendor compatibility list. Legal needs to sign an ATO appendix for HSM use.
Priya: Latency: our verified numbers for embed-512 on dedicated A100 pool: p50=20ms, p95=60ms at sustained 50 qps with small batching. Hosted multi-tenant shows p95 150-220ms in spikes. I'll attach the small-run benchmark CSV.
ops-bot: [automated] Uploaded files: vector_governance_draft.xlsx, bench_50qps.csv, poc_control_playbook.pdf. Shared with Lucas, Diego, Priya, Marta.
Diego: POC ops: recommend 2-week sandbox, isolated VPC + token rotation every 7 days, retention default 30d but can be set to 7d for POC. We can also enable an ingest scrub pipeline to remove PII at ingest time.
Lucas: Can we enforce per-tenant hard caps for Hosted POC? prospect insists no overage during trial.
Marta: For Hosted we can enforce API key usage caps (hard cutoffs). For Dedicated we can enforce spend caps via contract + runtime throttles. We'll include the exact mechanism in the RFI answer.
Priya: Add an entry: "Audit artifacts available" - we can provide request logs, key rotation history, and SOC2 extracts. ops-bot: [automated] SOC2 summary added to poc_control_playbook.pdf.
Diego: One small ask from them: "Can you provide a short statement on embedding drift monitoring?" Suggest we add: "We surface embed distribution metrics and similarity drift alerts tied to eval prompt sets; can integrate customer evals during POC."
Lucas: Good. Who will assemble the final package? I can send but need all files by Wed 15:00 PT.
Priya: I'll upload bench CSV + a short note on batching config by Tue EOD.
Marta: I'll prepare a one-paragraph KMS/HSM attestation and a checklist for legal that they can show to their auditors.
Diego: I'll finalize pricing table and a sample 6-month commit with monthly caps. Also add cost cap language: "No bill > agreed cap during POC; overage rules in contract."
Lucas: Action items recap in the matrix: Diego - pricing + sample commit; Priya - perf CSV + batching note; Marta - KMS attestation + legal checklist; Lucas - finalize RFI cover email and send once all attachments are in. Target send: Wed 16:00 PT.
Priya: tiny note: include a short FAQ row: "How to remove PII from embeddings?" Suggested answer: "Use client-side masking or our ingest-scrub pipeline; we do not retain raw input beyond configured retention for Hosted/Dedicated; Private gives full customer control."
Diego: Uploaded vector_governance_v2.xlsx and pricing_examples.csv. Link: https://files.redwood/vector_governance_v2.xlsx
Marta: Uploaded kms_attestation.pdf (draft). Pls review.
Lucas: Thanks team. If nothing else, I'll assemble the packet Wed morning and send to Aegis. Ping here if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
